description: Capture ONE bounded target from the immutable LMS visual-audit plan through the real hosted worker renderer. Target states are a closed vocabulary: CONTENT/ASSESSMENT_UNANSWERED render as-is; ASSESSMENT_INCORRECT_FEEDBACK/ASSESSMENT_PASSED (standard sessions) and MASTERY_RUN_FAILED/MASTERY_CARRY_LOCK_REDO/MASTERY_RUN_PASSED (mastery sessions, module-scoped) are DERIVED server-side through the canonical graders — answer keys never cross the wire, the verdict is verified before capture (409 AUDIT_STATE_UNPROVABLE otherwise), and the response carries a worker-safe stateProof. Derived transitions are receipt-bound per target, so a retried capture replays the original revision/proof instead of double-applying. Call in target-index order, threading the RESPONSE stateRevision. Never writes assignments, Project To-dos, Forms attempts, learner progress, or notifications. Requires lms:write.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable idempotency key. Reuse only for the identical operation.

name: opentrain_lms_capture_preview_audit_target
